selection_policy: Root reviewed target identity, capture independence, ROI and catalog-unit exclusion before inference. No OCR/model outcome used in photo selection. New groups chronological; prior anchor keeps previous order.
evaluation_policy: First predetermined photo vs three; additionally each photo standalone. Frozen retrieval-only, selective VLM, forced VLM. No model/catalog/prompt/fusion tuning.
limitations: Eight physical-unit hypotheses, not a representative population or blind holdout.
Seven still-photo groups; one video-frame group from one recording, reported separately.
All same-unit identities visually supported; zero owner/expert confirmations.
UA741 and ATMEGA328P each reuse one historical44 query capture; prior I80286 anchor reused. Full209 overlap recorded per source.

Crops isolate target components and may omit pin tips or include real board context/occluders as declared. This tests recognition/fusion on supplied component crops, not automatic board-wide detection.
